Name: Interiors of Pelican Town - The Mullner Residence - Evelyn George Alex
Author: QueenAcademe
Description:
[b]Description

[/b]The "Interiors of Pelican Town" suite of mods redesigns the homes and common spaces of Pelican Town. 

[b]Compatibility [/b]

IoPT is compatible with all recolors (yay!)

[b]Known Bugs[/b]

There are a few minor visual glitches (mostly clipping) during cutscenes; these will not affect gameplay. 

[b]Credits

[/b]This project would not have been possible without the generosity and immense artistic talents of the following mod authors. Please visit their profiles, download their fantastic mods, and give them a well-deserved endorsement.
